messages:
Aisha: Heads up — we keep getting similar feature asks around per-route billing visibility and onboarding docs. I'm proposing a short CS -> Product feedback handbook for categorization/triage. Draft below. Thoughts? :memo:

Mateo: love it. Do we have required fields for each capture? customer, MRR, use-case, repro steps, business impact?

Aisha: yep thinking: customer name, contact, MRR/Tier, concise problem statement, example prompt/workflow, frequency (daily/weekly), impact estimate (lost revenue/blocks feature launch), account health score, renewal_risk (low/med/high), suggested priority (P1/P2/P3), slack thread link, screenshot/log.

Jun: can we add "existing workaround" and "must-have vs nice-to-have"? Product needs that to avoid bouncing back.

Ravi: +1. Also add a quick "product fit" checkbox: (fits roadmap / could be solved by config / needs new infra). Will set default triage rubric: impact_score 1-5 and confidence 1-5.

Leah: onboarding-specific note — tag as #onboarding if it's friction in first 30 days, and attach any training materials customers saw. Also link to enablement playbook.

Mateo: sample capture template (one-line):
```
Customer: HealthCo
Contact: jane@healthco.com
Tier: Enterprise
Problem: per-route cost breakdown missing for custom routes
Example: POST /v1/generate ...
Frequency: daily
Impact: blocks billing reconciliation (>$2k/mo)
Workaround: manual CSV export
Suggested priority: P2
Account health: 68
Renewal risk: medium
```

Aisha: perfect. Who can own the handbook doc? I'll draft first pass by Fri. @Jun @Ravi volunteer?

Jun: I can take first pass on the triage rubric. Will include a mapping to dev labels and SLA for CS responses.

Ravi: I'll map to product repo labels and add a nightly sync between our feedback tracker and JIRA. Also let's add a rule: if renewal_risk=high OR account_health<50 -> escalate to AM with 24h SLA.

Leah: can we add a small "enablement brief" template to send customers acknowledging the ask + quick workaround? Keeps them calm during triage.

Aisha: yes. I'll include one-liner templates. Also let's pilot this with next week's onboard cohort (4 accounts). If anyone has objections, say now. :eyes:

Mateo: none. :+1:

feedback-bot: Captured 2 tickets from Intercom last 24h tagged per-route-billing (IDs: FB-432, FB-433) — auto-import queued.

Aisha: great. Next steps: Jun (rubric) by Wed, Aisha (handbook + templates) by Fri, Ravi (repo labels + nightly sync) by Mon. We'll test pilot and report back in CS sync next Tues. Thanks team!
